examples.text: Aus der Tüte rieselte pulverförmiges Waschmittel.

glosses: which has been made into a powder
which has been covered with powder (typically referring to makeup)
simple past and past participle of powder

examples.text: We were plowing through great deeps of powdery alkali dust that rose in thick clouds and floated across the plain like smoke from a burning house. We were coated with it like millers; so were the coach, the mules, the mail-bags, the driver—we and the sage-brush and the other scenery were all one monotonous color.
